title: RCPT TO validation: any address accepted — no recipient domain validation or local delivery check
description: session.rs RCPT handler: every RCPT TO address is accepted with 250 OK regardless of the recipient domain. This means port 25 (inbound MX) will accept and queue messages addressed to any domain, not just the operator's domain. For an MX server this is expected only for configured local domains; accepting mail for arbitrary destinations and then delivering via Sieve is an open relay. The test test_rcpt_any_address_accepted explicitly tests and asserts this behavior as correct, but it is only safe if the server is not reachable from the public internet on port 25.
